items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Well that's all brothers. So we all came up just as brothers

ctx.x: but I mean it would give me an idea, you know what I mean? Who were some of the other good bass players? Well he's starting, Bill Moran's son. Simon. You ever heard of Simon? Yeah I've heard of Simon. You got a record of him? No, I don't think he made any, yeah he made some records for Settles to him, but otherwise I never knew him.

Well that's another nice boy. And then he got another brother, played bass too, Eddie. Eddie Moran. Yeah we interviewed him. And Lawrence Moran, you got him too didn't you? Well that's all brothers. So we all came up just as brothers, because we used to go down there and Simon would take the bass, I'd take the bass, and you know what I mean, we'd get together with one another, the show one another. Where did they live in those days? They was living down at Spain Street on Spain between Vire and Oikwar. That's…
Yeah, that's right. A couple of other questions I had. Did you play with Chris Kelly?
